0x19ab453c.notice: Runs the HSS adapter + access-control module initializers. MUST be invoked via the diamond's `initialize` `_init` delegatecall.

natspec.notice: One-shot initializer for a Hedera Schedule Service diamond — seeds AccessControl, grants `admin` the scheduler role (scheduling, deleting and authorizing schedules the diamond pays for) and registers the IHSSAdapter interface (ERC-165). Delegatecalled by {Diamond.initialize} inside the initializing window (so it must NOT open its own pre/postInitializer). Schedules are created later via `scheduleCall`, so no schedule reference is needed at init time.
